I saved the Q3 2025 answers to `/work/answer.json`. Run the same way on Q2, my calculation gives exactly the reference values you provided (all 10).

| Item | Q3 result |
|---|---|
| a. Segment with the highest net sales | consumer, 353,588,404 KRW |
| b. Customers with paid orders | 240 |
| c. Category with the highest net sales | sw, 306,179,578 KRW |
| d. Month with the highest net sales | 2025-07 |
| e. Customer with the most refunds | u89@ex.com |
| f. Customers with 2+ paid orders | 229 |
| g. Average net sales per order | 679,774 KRW |
| h. August→September growth | 7.6% |

The DB has a few inconsistencies, so I applied the following to match the Q2 reference values:
- **Time zone:** Order times are stored in UTC. I converted them to Korean time (UTC+9) to decide which month and quarter each order falls in. Without the conversion, the Q2 reference values don't come out.
- **Duplicate customers:** Some emails appear more than once, differing only in letter case (300 customer records, 250 unique emails). In b, e and f, I treated records with the same email (ignoring case and surrounding spaces) as one customer.
- **Segment names:** Some have different letter case or extra spaces (e.g. " consumer", "Enterprise "). I lowercased them and trimmed the spaces before grouping.
- **Order status:** I applied the same lowercasing and trimming when checking for "paid".

STATUS: DONE
